thread:
olivia: FYI customer reported promo credits disappeared earlier than their dashboard shows. acct: acct_9z2x, promo WELCOME50. They say credits expired 00:00 local (NZ) yesterday but our invoice already charged them.
devon: ugh, timezone shenanigans. do we have repro steps? was the promo TTL set in UTC or tenant-local? :thinking_face:
olivia: Looks like promo rows in DB had expiry stored as DATE in UTC but our scheduler uses local server tz (UTC-7) when evaluating expiring credits. customer is +12, so their credits were considered expired ~1 day earlier in local time. they got charged for usage on their free day.
billing-bot: invoice generated for acct_9z2x at 2026-09-03T07:12:05Z (inv_20260903_47). Usage applied: 1.2M tokens. Promo applied: 0 tokens.
sam: can we backfill the promo application for the window they lost? we should also pause charges while we investigate.
maria: I grabbed the query we use to mark expirations. posted snippet:

```
-- marks promo credits expired
UPDATE promo_credits
SET status = 'expired'
WHERE expires_at < now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC-7'
  AND status = 'active';
```

support-joe: that AT TIME ZONE shift is the culprit. scheduler was changed to server local tz in 2025 migration patch. customer promos were created with a UTC date only (no timezone), so shift moved it earlier for customers ahead of server tz.
devon: proposed fix: always compare against UTC midnight or store expires_at as timestamptz normalized to UTC. quick mitigation: re-run expiry job with account-local tz awareness for the last 48h and re-evaluate invoices.
eng-bill: filing a short incident and backfill plan. I'll open PR to normalize expiry logic and add a regression test. also propose credit backfill script to apply credits and create invoice adjustments.
maria: repro steps for billing eng:
1) run the current expiry query against a replica for acct_9z2x for date range 2026-08-31..2026-09-03
2) run corrected query using UTC compare
3) diff results -> accounts that flipped status

```
-- corrected check
UPDATE promo_credits
SET status = 'expired'
WHERE expires_at < now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
  AND status = 'active';
```

sam: How many customers affected? any rough estimate?
eng-bill: quick scan shows ~120 accounts created in APAC with date-only promos in July/Aug could be at risk. I'll run a safe-check and post results.
olivia: For this specific acct customer wants a reversal and restored credits for Sept 2 usage. they attached screenshots of dashboard showing 24h left.
support-joe: action items:
- eng-bill to run safe detection and produce list (ETA 2h)
- eng-bill to push PR to normalize expiry logic (ETA EOD)
- billing ops (maria) to queue invoice adjustment for acct_9z2x if backfill confirms (ETA after detection)
- support to send hold message to customer: we are investigating and will not finalize charges until resolved. (I'll ping now)
maria: pinging finance for temporary hold on inv_20260903_47.
billing-bot: finance hold request submitted for inv_20260903_47, ticket finance-789.
sam: thanks. once eng posts list we should triage high-severity customers and auto-backfill small amounts without manual invoice churn.
olivia: customer updated: appreciate quick response, asked for ETA on credit restoration, offered a screenshot with usage timestamps.
eng-bill: posted preliminary list: 14 high-priority accounts, 96 medium, 10 low. starting backfill run for top 5 now. will update with run logs.
devon: when backfilling, ensure we create an audit record and don't double-apply for customers who already got manual credits.
support-joe: got it. I'll include the audit guidance in ops playbook.
maria: final note — add an automated regression for timezone handling in our promo test harness. this should prevent server tz drift from causing expiry flips.
olivia: closing loop: customer credited ~25k tokens as immediate remediation and finance reversed the invoice pending final cleanup. will follow up with a postmortem.
eng-bill: linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/842 (normalize-expiry-tz). includes unit/regression tests and backfill plan.
support-joe: thanks everyone. will update thread with final PM/postmortem once PR merges and backfills finish. :thumbsup:
